psychological_meaning: Tia Maria evokes feelings of warmth, comfort, and sophistication. This deep, reddish-brown color is associated with the earth, providing a sense of stability and reliability. It can also suggest indulgence and luxury, reminiscent of the rich flavors found in the liqueur it's named after.
